nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point. POST from NestJS with the envelope {runId, ownerId, jobId, agentId, payload}. Checks the X-Agora-Secret header and answers 200 at once; the work continues in the background.

nodes.name: Read envelope
nodes.notes: Takes the request body and flattens envelope + payload into one item, so later nodes can read $('Read envelope').first().json.jobId and friends. Stops if runId is missing.

nodes.name: Load bid
nodes.notes: Reads the bid's price, job and category.

parameters.query:
-- settled jobs in the category + live bids on other jobs in the category
SELECT price FROM (
  SELECT j.agreed_price AS price
    FROM jobs j
   WHERE j.category = $2 AND j.status = 'settled' AND j.agreed_price IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT x.price
    FROM bids x JOIN jobs j ON j.id = x.job_id
   WHERE j.category = $2 AND x.job_id <> $1::uuid
     AND x.status IN ('live', 'shortlisted', 'accepted')
) r
LIMIT 200;

nodes.name: Reference prices
nodes.notes: Settled jobs in the category plus live bids on other jobs in the category.

nodes.name: Apply rule
nodes.notes: Median of the prices. Under 30% or over 300% of the median = held. Fewer than 5 prices = unverified.

parameters.query:
UPDATE bids
   SET price_check = $2::price_check_result,
       reference_median = $3::numeric,
       reference_sample_size = $4::int,
       hold_reason = $5,
       status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'held' THEN 'held'::bid_status ELSE status END
 WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Save result
nodes.notes: Writes price_check, reference_median, sample size and hold_reason; held bids get status held.

nodes.name: Finish
nodes.notes: Builds one item with the feed message for agent_events and the 'notify' body for NestJS. Messages are written for the owner to read.

nodes.name: Log event
nodes.notes: Calls lib log-event: inserts the row into agent_events (the live activity feed).

nodes.name: Notify Nest
nodes.notes: Calls lib notify-nest: POST /agents/notify so NestJS moves the job to its next step. Errors are ignored, so the agent still works while Nest is not built.
